title: Lena and the Letters
author: Hazel Voss
blurb: Yara Brightwater, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
